About.title: About
About.subtitle: A little more about me and how I work.
About.p1: I build whole products - from the interface down to the database schema and the server that runs it. In practice that means a Next.js front end, a REST API in Go, schema and migrations in PostgreSQL, and the whole thing shipped as Docker containers through GitHub Actions.
About.p2: This site is one of those builds: three services - the public site, an admin CMS and the Go API - running behind Caddy on a single VPS, redeployed on every push. I care about the details a visitor never notices but always feels: fast loads, predictable behaviour, and code the next person - usually future me - can follow.
About.stackTitle: How I work across the stack
About.contactText: I'm open to interesting projects and collaborations. Email, Telegram or a call - whichever suits you.

Uses.title: Uses
Uses.subtitle: Everything that actually runs this site.
Uses.intro: Not an aspirational stack - the real contents of the three repositories delivering this page. You can check every line of it against the site you are reading it on.
Uses.outro: When the list changes, this page changes first.
Uses.usesServerVps: Ubuntu 24.04, amd64 - one machine, everything on it
Uses.usesServerCompose: Five services on one machine: site, admin, API, database, proxy
Uses.usesServerCaddy: Reverse proxy and Let’s Encrypt certificates, automatically
Uses.usesServerCI: Every push builds an image, runs the tests and ships over SSH
Uses.usesBackendGo: The REST API - one compiled binary, no runtime dependencies
Uses.usesBackendChi: A small router; no framework underneath it
Uses.usesBackendPg: The single source of truth; never exposed to the internet
Uses.usesBackendSqlc: Generates Go from SQL - not an ORM, I write the queries
Uses.usesFrontendNext: With ISR: content comes from the database, pages stay static
Uses.usesFrontendIntl: uz and en, paired through hreflang and a translation key
Uses.usesFrontendMdx: Post bodies are MDX in the database, highlighted on the server
Uses.usesQualityVitest: Front-end unit tests; they run in CI before the build
Uses.usesQualityGoTest: Unit and integration tests against a real PostgreSQL
Uses.usesQualityBot: An ops bot in its own container - status, notifications, alerts

Footer.builtWith: Next.js and Go, self-hosted on a VPS with Docker and Caddy.
